zoe-sales: Quick help pls  Prospect (MedFin) needs POC runbook + final commit sizing. Traffic: 180 RPS sustained, spikes to 360 RPS, median gen ~200 tokens, occasional 2k tokens. They want reserved baseline + autoscale.

leo-eng: Which model/quant?

zoe-sales: 13B quantized (8k ctx) in sandbox.

nina-ml: Ballpark perf: 13B q4 @200 tokens ~65 RPS per A100-equivalent. 2k tokens ~0.35x throughput.

sam-sre: Sizing quick math: sustain 180 -> 3 reserved GPUs (65 RPS each -> 195). For bursts to 360 need +3 burst GPUs. AZ spread 2 AZs (2+1).

paul-platform: Recommend hybrid billing: 3 reserved GPUs monthly + prepaid burst credits (e.g., 150 GPU-hours) billed at reduced burst rate; overage per-hour if exceeded. I'll draft cost table.

leo-eng: Add runbook items: KV warmup script (top prompts), canary checklist, request token caps (max_gen=2048) to prevent OOMs.

sam-sre: Oncall: provide dedicated POC alias for first 72h, monitor p95, queue depth; play: add burst node -> if unhealthy in 5m route to fallback 13B-slim.

legal-bot: Reminder: attach completed security questionnaire for templated answers re: KMS, no persistent GPU storage, and EU data residency if required.

zoe-sales: Thanks. Can someone drop a one-pager + runbook by EOD? I need to send to their infra and legal teams. :pray:
